annotations.title: List Team Keys in a District

description: List team keys in an FRC district. Lightest enumeration of a district's teams; ideal for driving per-team lookups.

district_key.description: TBA district key combining the season year and district abbreviation (e.g., '2023fim' for FIRST in Michigan, '2024ne' for New England, '2024chs' for Chesapeake, '2024pnw' for Pacific Northwest, '2024fit' for FIRST In Texas). Use get_districts to enumerate valid district keys for a year.

name: get_district_teams_keys
